name: Downloads
author: Nikolay Yasinskiy
description: Shows an animated arrow in the bar while anything downloads in the background, with a popup listing each download and its progress.

barWidget.description: Background downloads from package managers, game launchers, Proton, curl, git and more.

schema.label: Always show
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar even when nothing is downloading.

schema.label: Show speed
schema.description: Show the current download speed next to the arrow.

schema.label: Notify when finished
schema.description: Send a notification when a background download finishes.

schema.label: Extra programs
schema.description: Comma-separated process names to watch in addition to the built-in list.
